Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset, not a concept illustration.
Create one transparent RGBA pixel-art sprite sheet for Torii & Hutukara, a 16-bit top-down action RPG. Input image 1 is ONLY a style/material reference from this game's boss floor-power effect. Do not reproduce its ring.
SPRITESHEET: 4 columns x 2 rows = exactly 8 sequential frames, chronological left-to-right then next row. Full image ratio 2:1. Equal square cells; for a logical export each cell is128x128, final sheet512x256. Leave a fully transparent 20% gutter INSIDE every cell on all four sides, especially vertical/horizontal dividers; no art crossing cell edges. No labels, numbers, grids, text.
SUBJECT: powerful shield-strike pressure wave moving toward RIGHT (+X), viewed from above/three-quarter ground perspective. This is a SPRITE OF POWER filling a short forward attack sector, NOT a drum, shield, weapon, music symbol, note, icon, logo, arrow, circular ring or rune.
Important: previous version was only a few thin wispy lines and invisible during gameplay. Make this new effect materially thick and very readable. Broad serrated ridges of COPPER/AMBER force, concentrated IVORY WHITE luminous rocklike pressure cores, a few chunky broken earthy fragments. At peak3/4, solid matter occupies35–50% of the useful bounding region, with LARGE irregular transparent holes between thick branches so game floor stays visible. Think broad branching ground shock and turbulent raised jagged layers, not outlines or three threads, no faint glowing smoke. Thick white/ivory clusters and burnt copper shadows. No heavy opaque wedge fill.
Eight distinct phases:0 small compressed gathering LEFT near x35 of logical cell;1 force piles and buckles right;2 two thick jagged fronts begin erupting right;3 powerful burst fills wide forward fan from x30 to100 and y25 to100 with layered broken masses and large gaps;4 fully extended broad breaking front around x100 with separating chunky branches;5 forms rupture into separate copper/ivory masses;6 pieces spread and dim;7 last few disconnected flecks. Keep nominal scale and cell coordinates fixed across sequence, don't enlarge each frame to fit. Motion advances materially toward right, shape changes with physical rupture and dissipation, NOT same shape scaled. All content well away from edges.
STYLE: match clustered coarse 16-bit pixels of reference, no soft vector gradients or photography. Genuine transparent alpha background, no matte, no outline rectangle, no checkerboard drawn. No environment, characters, UI, instruments, musical notation. Sprite content full anatomy intact and no fragments cut by frame boundaries.
